correctness.rationale: A complete five-step proof defines stationary alternating renewal, proves contractive uniqueness and bounded support, proves the exact two-sign renewal-age identity, bounds the previous-run gap from below by 2(1-exp(-U)), applies integrated regular variation with dominated convergence, and derives the reciprocal-gap moment divergence. Direct numerical reproduction in the bundled script gave 24 passing comparisons over Lomax and half-t waiting laws. Finite tests are not mistaken for proof.

value.rationale: The exact spatial mass coefficient distinguishes power-law waiting-time accumulation from the Markovian distance-power law in a physically motivated trapped active particle. The canonical Lomax constant 1/2, half-t constant 1/4, exact finite-threshold representation and divergence of all reciprocal-wall-distance moments quantify a natural endpoint invariant left unevaluated by the closest numerically oriented non-Markovian-trap source. This requires combining stationary renewal length bias, entrance-gap control and exponential trap relaxation; it is more than a normalization check or trivial case of a source closed formula.
